name: Natsuiro Kami Hikouki
source:
This VN is a story about some people, some paper airplanes, and 2 summers shared between them that they will never forget. Unlike just about every other VN out there, this story doesn’t involve romance between the heros and heroines. Instead, it focuses on weaving a beautiful environment and touching interactions between characters. 

[From [url=http://calamitousintents.wordpress.com/2010/08/16/never-stop/]Calamitous Intent[/url]]
